business_delta: From accepted A17, retain two explicit units at BASE-01 and BASE-02, but remove the group and give the one scheduled two-aircraft BASIC-MISSION to ordinary TEACH-UNIT. Keep one aircraft at the ordinary unit; deploy two at TEACH-UNIT-2. Add AlternateUnit TEACH-UNIT to TEACH-UNIT-2 with PRI=1. The two child inputs differ only in Control.ENALU Y versus N and description. Seed, horizon, mission type, schedule and support data are otherwise unchanged.
hand_timeline_hypothesis: With ENALU=Y, the ordinary unit is one aircraft short of MNOS=2 at the hour-7 mission call. The two-ready-aircraft alternate should receive the whole mission, start both aircraft at hour 8, succeed at hour 10 and return them to its unit. With ENALU=N, the original unit should remain short, not start a mission and cancel at the hour-8.3333 deadline. Native timestamps and allocation messages decide discrepancies.
pre_run_metric_hypothesis: Enabled should give one started/successful fixed wave and four aircraft-hours, with MSTF=MSUF=MTMF=STMF=1 for the two-aircraft two-hour mission. Disabled should give no launched wave, zero operation hours and zero fixed start/success factors. The enabled versus disabled pair should have identical source rows except description and ENALU.
acceptance_requires: accepted A17 parent, installed source hashes, deterministic builder and exact parent/control deltas
fresh paired five-step session-0 SSH native runs under host mutex and GUI PID13340 guard
exact populated business-table import/export roundtrips and zero conversion errors for both variants
enabled native events explicitly identify alternate unit's two aircraft and one successful two-aircraft mission; disabled has no launch or success
System/Stock interval ledgers, fixed summary factors, absence of faults and terminal readiness reconcile to both event histories
sealed raw SHA-256 artifacts and separate independent read-only replay
diagnostic_rule: If AlternateUnit input is rejected, unintended default missions appear, a different unit supplies the mission, the disabled control starts, or native ledgers do not reconcile, retain immutable runs as diagnostics and do not publish the transfer claim.
limitations: One seed, one scheduled fixed demand, one alternate unit and no failures or resource contention.
Two-alternate priority ordering, delayed alternate readiness, reassignment after call, ENALU failure branches, explicit formations, GUI and cross-engine behavior remain outside this claim.
